'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Stephen Kin LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kin]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' raith
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
